Quantum Information in Quantum Gravity 2026 (QIQG 2026)
The conference will be held at Tsinghua University from June 27 to July 1, 2026.Building on the discussions of QIQG 2025, QIQG 2026 will propel the dialogue into a new era of further synthesis of ideas in quantum information theory and quantum gravity and their applications.
